Hello Eduard, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
There was a communication drop with the charging controller. After restarting the controller, the connector is back online and operational.
I offer my recommendation to update the charger which is in v6.0.3 to the latest v8.0.5 which has a lot of fixes and improvements.
I will wait for your feedback before closing the ticket.
Best regards,
Francisco
